state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: On topic-based summarisation the paper reports that larger models are better at critiquing their own outputs, even without filtering for critiqueable answers and even though their answers are harder to critique. On synthetic tasks the authors generally observe similar trends in the critiqueable case, though the story is less clear, and they state they have no strong reason to believe positive critique scaling is a fundamental trend, nor know whether it would survive RL training of both answer and critique models.
title: On topic-based summarisation, larger models are better at self-critiquing despite harder-to-critique answers
